upstreamShift.summary: Semantic pivot from 'confined workspace file service (Agent-bound)' to 'read-only file preview surface with header-derived scope (Session-bound)'. Reads follow filesystem access even outside the workspace root; workspace containment is retained only for directory listing and change observation. Two new Remote methods (readAll, readRelated) are added for full-file previews and same-dir relative reads. The wire parameter changes from `Agent` to a new `WorkspaceFileScope` derived from a `typert.lookups.register('workspaceFileScope', ...)` registered against `sessions` and `sessionPersistence` at construction. A new `maxFileBytes` config cap is added. Deps drop `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`; add `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types`. `static inject` changes: adds `'sessions'`, drops none but no longer relies on Agent. Client provider: `SessionLookup` and `WorkspaceFileResource` (with `changed` flag + `restat` notice) are removed; provider now yields `WorkspaceFileStat` directly and `absolute` addresses are unsupported (were 'read through current Session'). Version bump 0.1.3-alpha.2 -> 0.1.5-rc.2. New test files: read-all.spec.ts (+113), scope.spec.ts (+75). READMEs (en+zh) rewritten with corresponding narrative.
keyRefactors: src/index.ts: replace `agent: Agent` parameter with `workspaceFileScope: WorkspaceFileScope` on read/readBytes/stat/list/changes (5 Remote methods).
src/index.ts: add Remote methods `readAll(scope, path, signal)` and `readRelated(scope, path, relativePath, signal)` (posix/win32 join, NUL/URL guard).

src/index.ts: register `typert.lookups` entry `workspaceFileScope` (wire=`workspaceFileScopeId`, hostTypeSymbol `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files#WorkspaceFileScope`, wireTypeSymbol `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types#SessionId`) in constructor via `ctx.inject(['sessions','typert'], ...)`.

src/index.ts: `static inject` gains `'sessions'`; drops the requirement for `Agent`. Uses `scope.sessions.get(sessionId)?.header` with `sessionPersistence.stat` fallback; workspaceRoot = `header.cwd ?? sandboxPolicy.workspaceRoot`.
src/index.ts: `locateFile` no longer routes through `confine()` — uses `ctx.fs.resolve(path, { cwd: workspaceRoot })` directly (containment relaxed for file reads).
src/index.ts: adds `maxFileBytes` config (default 32 MiB) with `workspace-file/too-large` gate in `readAll`.
src/types.ts: `workspace-file/outside-workspace` scope narrows to directory listings only.
src/client/provider.ts: removes `SessionLookup`, `sessions` argument, and `absolute` scope wired-through-Session behavior; `absolute` addresses now yield `workspace-file/unknown-workspace`.
src/client/types.ts: removes `WorkspaceFileResource` type entirely — resource protocol map `file` becomes `WorkspaceFileStat`. Removes `restat` notice kind.
src/client/change-feed.ts: simplified (51-line delta); loses ~a third of code, aligned with removal of `restat`/`WorkspaceFileResource`.
package.json: version 0.1.3-alpha.2 -> 0.1.5-rc.2; drops `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` from client inject + devDeps; adds `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence`.

Any caller that still calls `remote.workspaceFiles.read(agent, path, ...)` or `remote.workspaceFiles.list(sessionId, path, ...)` compiles differently. `createFileResourceProvider(remote, changes, sessions)` becomes `createFileResourceProvider(remote, changes)` — SessionLookup positional argument removed. Fork clients in `src/client/index.ts:28-32` (this same seam) already updated in upstream.
